## FINAL STATE — run 30880394880. 17 criteria met; criterion 11 discharged as the operator's coverage reading.

The J11 suite's arc across tonight's four runs, all on the same pinned DC 8.17.1 image:

    30857265932 (baseline)   collected=58  6 failed / 51 passed / 1 xfailed
    30867072561              collected=58  5 failed / 52 passed / 1 xfailed
    30874380112              collected=61  4 failed / 56 passed / 1 xfailed
    30880394880 (final)      collected=61  3 failed / 57 passed / 1 xfailed

**Collected rose 58 -> 61 while failures fell 6 -> 3.** That direction matters more than either number: coverage was ADDED (three new cells — the pass-level epic parent, epic-parent idempotence, and the sub-task refusal) at the same time as reds were removed, so the improvement was not bought by deleting or skipping anything. `skipped` stayed at exactly 1 — the canary baseline — in every single run.

### Criterion 11, per the operator's settled ruling

Criterion 11 asks that every mutation round-trips and is asserted individually. It is discharged as the **coverage reading**, with the shortfall filed as epic children rather than papered over. Every one of those children is now CLOSED:

    3fe5  harness had no Epic issue type                          closed
    39c1  emit gate and apply gate disjoint                       closed
    9bb9  parent sync one-way — inbound never read the Epic Link  closed
    1a9f  sub-task reparent accepted-and-ignored                  closed
    37e7  DC refuses to null a sub-task's parent                  closed
    18a5  outbound CREATE never bound                             closed
    339a  88d9's clear unreachable in a bidirectional pass        closed  (discovered tonight)

**The 3 remaining reds are ONE platform limitation, not three defects.** All are Data Center's refusal to move or clear a **sub-task's** `fields.parent`:

    test_inbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips
    test_outbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips
    test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips

That limitation is measured, documented in `docs/jira-dc-capability-map.md` with its evidence ids, and its bug (1a9f) is closed with the transport now REFUSING the write instead of reporting a mutation that never happened. The cells assert a round-trip the platform cannot perform; they are red for a true reason, and their red is the honest coverage reading rather than a defect awaiting a fix.

### Criteria 2, 3 and 18 remain WEAK, and I am not silently upgrading them

Each re-reads a value the same fixture set moments earlier, so they catch stray ambient state but cannot verify the fixture's own logic. Unchanged from the earlier verification pass, recorded rather than fixed, and no product behaviour rests on them. Ticking them as MET would be the same substitution this epic spent the night learning to refuse.
